title: OpenDEA Response Specification
description: The declared shape of a Question's answer (CR-AM-05A §20). Not every question returns a maturity score (§1.6); the response type constrains which constraint fields are meaningful. The response records what the assessor/mechanism received; the Observation carries the assessed fact (§21).

options.description: Declared option set. Meaningful only for single-choice, multi-choice and ordinal types.

sequence.description: Ordering position; meaningful for ordinal responses.

min.description: Inclusive lower bound. Meaningful for numeric, percentage and duration types.

max.description: Inclusive upper bound. Meaningful for numeric, percentage and duration types.

unit.description: Unit of measure (e.g. percent, hours, per-day). Meaningful for numeric, percentage, duration, frequency and measurement types.
